description: Unit test for DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl, testing response building and error conditions for delete feature definition commands in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying behavior of DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl, including response creation and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the mock command and the object under test before each test.

methods.name: tryToGetNewInstanceWithNullCommand
methods.description: Tests that passing null to newInstance() throws a NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithDeleteFeatureDefinitionResponseOnly
methods.description: Verifies that a successful delete response produces a LiveCommandAnswer with no event and a response.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithFeatureDefinitionNotAccessibleErrorResponseOnly
methods.description: Verifies that an inaccessible feature error produces a ThingErrorResponse with status 404 and correct exception type.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithFeatureDefinitionNotModifiableErrorResponseOnly
methods.description: Verifies that a non-modifiable feature error produces a ThingErrorResponse with status 403 and correct exception type.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithFeatureDefinitionDeletedEventOnly
methods.description: Verifies that a delete event produces a LiveCommandAnswer with a modified event and no response.
